words.definition: to increase speed; to cause something to happen sooner
words.example: The action of molecules accelerates when they are heated.
words.zh: 提高速度；使某事更快發生

words.definition: to press together so as to completely distort the shape or nature of the object
words.example: The machine crushes corn to produce cornmeal.
words.zh: 壓在一起以完全扭曲物體的形狀或性質

words.definition: to plant and raise a crop; to encourage growth of a relationship or friendship
words.example: The professionals had common interests that allowed them to cultivate a working relationship with each other.
words.zh: 種植和種植農作物；促進關係或友誼的發展

words.definition: to come from or find something from its starting point
words.example: The English word "decadent" is derived from the Latin word "decadere.
words.zh: 來自或從起點找到某物

words.definition: to state demands with the power to enforce
words.example: The workers were not in a position to dictate demands to management.

words.definition: to hear, see, or recognize differences
words.example: Some people cannot distinguish colors well.

words.definition: docility a.qi. easy to control or train
words.example: The moose is typically a veiy docile animal.
words.zh: 溫順 a.qi.易於控製或訓練

words.definition: to cause something new to exist; to create
words.zh: 導致新事物的存在；創造

words.definition: to become completely occupied or involved in an activity
words.example: The teacher's lecture engrossed the entire class.
words.zh: 完全投入或參與某項活動

words.definition: a small sign of damage that makes an item
words.example: There is a flaw in his theory.
words.zh: 造成物品損壞的小跡象

words.definition: the act of collecting a crop; the crops gathered
words.example: The United States had a comparatively good grain harvest this year.
words.zh: 收集農作物的行為；農作物收穫了

words.example: Building the new bridge was a mammoth task that required thousands of workers.

words.definition: to show, as in a mirror
words.example: The results of the study mirror public opinion.
words.zh: 展示，就像在鏡子裡一樣

words.definition: to find a middle ground, come to an agreement
words.example: He negotiated with his teacher for an extension on the project.
words.zh: 找到中間立場，達成協議

words.example: The university obtained a new particle accelerator.

words.definition: a very small piece of something
words.example: Particles of dust can destroy electronic instruments.

words.definition: to move from one place to another
words.example: Flying is not always the fastest way to transport passengers to their destination.
words.zh: 從一個地方移動到另一個地方
